_comment: Hand-written briefs per package id (SLS Casting Shred - RANGER - Ensemble - 2026-10-04). Keys match the Package cell in the scenario grids.

B1.why: The one Extremely High fee goes where the script puts the gravitas (the President), the Ethan slot buys the most authentic Ranger in the Director's pool at a Med-High band, and Natalie and Richard are cast for credibility. Honors the Studio Brief's Costner attachment without stacking a second marquee fee.
good: 84% probability of success with a 3.4x median ROI, the best in the grid.
Every must-pair scores 8 or above; Basso and Sarsgaard (9) and Spaeny and Costner (9) are the two scenes the film is sold on.
Ages cohere: Basso 32 and Spaeny 29 at shoot read as a couple in their twenties; Costner 72 and Sarsgaard 55 read as fathers of those children.
Basso is wrapped on The Night Agent and available; Sarsgaard's windows are open.
bad: Costner's fee against a $13.29M cast line is the single arithmetic risk; the offer has to be capped and structured.
Spaeny's Deep Cuts and Elden Ring commitments make her window the second scheduling risk.
ugly: If Costner's Horizon Chapters 3 and 4 move into the 2027 window, the package loses its anchor and B2 or B3 becomes the plan.
caveats: Bands are leverage bands, not quotes; gate every LOI on a cap.
Chemistry read for Basso and Spaeny before the LOIs go out together.
Director to confirm Ethan may read up to 32 at shoot.

A3.verdict: RECOMMEND if Galitzine's band holds at High
A3.why: The Sales-Max upgrade of B1: swap Basso for Galitzine to add a GQ leading man with a Marine precedent (Purple Hearts, The Mosquito Bowl) and UK/EU presale value, while keeping one Extremely High fee.
good: 82% probability of success at 3.0x; highest buyer recognition of any one-marquee package.
Galitzine is the only pool name who is both the trust-fund kid and a proven on-screen Marine.
bad: Galitzine's band moves with Masters of the Universe (June 2026); if it opens big he becomes a second Extremely High fee.
Ranger prep must be contractual; he has not yet carried a combat film as the lead.
ugly: Two schedule-fluid names (Costner, Galitzine) in one package can slide the start date past the Georgia incentive window.
caveats: Re-check Galitzine's band with the sales agent after MOTU opens before choosing A3 over B1.

B2.why: The Costner-declines package. Rob Lowe gives the exact distinguished look at a Med-High band, and Galitzine and Carson arrive as a proven military-romance pairing from Purple Hearts.
good: 80% probability of success at 3.3x with no Extremely High fee at all.
Galitzine and Carson chemistry is already on film; Carson adds LatAm reach and sings.
Lowe and Sarsgaard are both low availability risk.
bad: Lowe is familiarity rather than draw; foreign presales will lean entirely on Galitzine.
Carson reads 27-29, at the edge of Natalie's age band.
ugly: Without a Costner-class anchor the faith-audience and foreign-buyer split widens; the package needs a streamer partner to be safe.
caveats: Pursue only after Costner and McConaughey have formally passed.

B3.why: The McConaughey version of the Balanced package: Southern-native President, the strongest fight-back Natalie, Basso's authentic Ranger and a Georgia-authentic Richard at the lowest band.
good: McConaughey is Low risk (20/100) and carries comeback press.
Whigham frees cast-line room for the leads.
bad: Dever's The Last of Us season 3 and Godzilla x Kong press are a real schedule gate.
Whigham is a recognized face, not a name, in the Richard slot.
ugly: McConaughey is 57 at shoot, under the President rubric's 58-72 band; the look has to be aged, not the script.
caveats: Run McConaughey's LOI in parallel with Costner's, not after it.

C2.verdict: CONSIDER if cast line must drop
C2.why: Discovery under a marquee: Costner anchors, and the young leads come from the pool's lowest bands. Corlett has already shot opposite Costner in Headhunters.
good: 70% probability of success at 3.0x with the lowest young-lead cost in the grid.
A genuine discovery story for the campaign.
bad: No theatrical draw outside Costner; the film sells as his.
Van Patten and Corlett both need chemistry reads before any offer.
ugly: Little talent insurance for acquisitions buyers who need a second name on the one-sheet.
caveats: Only if the cast line is cut and the Costner cap is already agreed.

A1.why: Three Extremely High fees (Brown, Costner, Wahlberg) against a $13.29M cast line. Modeled for completeness, not for pursuit.
good: Highest raw recognition in the grid.
bad: Brown's fee is out of proportion to a co-lead load; Wahlberg's to a key-supporting load.
ugly: The fee stack erases the Georgia-incentive advantage the budget is built on.
